1.web: The words of king Lemuel; the oracle which his mother taught him.
1.asv: The words of king Lemuel; the oracle which his mother taught him.

2.web: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
2.asv: What, my son? and what, O son of my womb? And what, O son of my vows?

3.web: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
3.asv: Give not thy strength unto women, Nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

4.web: It is not for kings, Lemuel; it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
4.asv: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; Nor for princes to say, Where is strong drink?

5.web: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
5.asv: Lest they drink, and forget the law, And pervert the justice due to any that is afflicted.

6.web: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish; and wine to the bitter in soul:
6.asv: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, And wine unto the bitter in soul:

7.web: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
7.asv: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, And remember his misery no more.

8.web: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
8.asv: Open thy mouth for the dumb, In the cause of all such as are left desolate.

9.web: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
9.asv: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, And minister justice to the poor and needy.

10.web: Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies.
10.asv: A worthy woman who can find? For her price is far above rubies.

11.web: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
11.asv: The heart of her husband trusteth in her, And he shall have no lack of gain.

12.web: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
12.asv: She doeth him good and not evil All the days of her life.

13.web: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
13.asv: She seeketh wool and flax, And worketh willingly with her hands.

14.web: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
14.asv: She is like the merchant-ships; She bringeth her bread from afar.

15.web: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
15.asv: She riseth also while it is yet night, And giveth food to her household, And their task to her maidens.

16.web: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
16.asv: She considereth a field, and buyeth it; With the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

17.web: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
17.asv: She girdeth her loins with strength, And maketh strong her arms.

18.web: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
18.asv: She perceiveth that her merchandise is profitable; Her lamp goeth not out by night.

19.web: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
19.asv: She layeth her hands to the distaff, And her hands hold the spindle.

20.web: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
20.asv: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; Yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

21.web: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
21.asv: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; For all her household are clothed with scarlet.

22.web: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
22.asv: She maketh for herself carpets of tapestry; Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

23.web: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
23.asv: Her husband is known in the gates, When he sitteth among the elders of the land.

24.web: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
24.asv: She maketh linen garments and selleth them, And delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

25.web: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
25.asv: Strength and dignity are her clothing; And she laugheth at the time to come.

26.web: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Faithful instruction is on her tongue.
26.asv: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; And the law of kindness is on her tongue.

27.web: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
27.asv: She looketh well to the ways of her household, And eateth not the bread of idleness.

28.web: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
28.asv: Her children rise up, and call her blessed; Her husbandalso, and he praiseth her, saying:

29.web: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
29.asv: Many daughters have done worthily, But thou excellest them all.

30.web: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
30.asv: Grace is deceitful, and beauty is vain; Buta woman that feareth Jehovah, she shall be praised.

31.web: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
31.asv: Give her of the fruit of her hands; And let her works praise her in the gates.
